reviews.title: These are great drives
reviews.comment: As always, Samsung makes One of the best solid state drives on the market. Very reliable. Never had one fail yet and I have many. The only reason I have to buy new ones is to increase storage capacity. I have now standardize on the 1 TB size for my VMware servers and 512 GB for user’s pc or laptops. I use the SSD units for the first array (boot drives) and mechanical drives for medium to long term storage. Works great.
reviews.author: Kevin Greene
